_comment: The provenance sidecar `importers/models.py::stage_unit` writes beside each model unit, key by
key. Pinned from the Python side by `pipeline/tests/test_model_provenance_keys.py` and cited by
the C++ reader's own fixture in `Source/ElysiumUE/Private/Tests/ElysiumModelProvenanceTests.cpp`,
so `UElysiumModelProvenance::FromJson` cannot drift from the shape the stage writes. The
materials lane learned this the hard way: a reader composed to a contract nobody diffed against
the stage read a shape the stage never wrote, and ~60% of the fields were silently empty.
`editorAdded` is the one key the editor import (`pipeline/unreal/import_models.py`) adds on top
of the sidecar before `apply_json`: the cooked simple-collision shape count, which the offline
stage cannot know. `rowLabelKeys` are the two label spellings each anomaly/omission array
carries -- this lane's own rows say `kind`, the unit's own export rows say `row` (anomalies) or
`reason` (omissions) -- because the stage merges both sources verbatim.
